US President Donald Trump says he “would not use” nuclear weapons against Iran, adding he did not see “putting US troops on the ground” there.
The Saudi-led coalition spokesperson says coalition forces intercepted and destroyed a drone launched towards Saudi Arabia’s Eastern Province.
